sources.title: A note on the topology of polyhedral hypersurfaces and complete intersections
sources.author: Karim Adiprasito
sources.inspection: Full author PDF read in memory. Theorem1.2 stable regular pointed hypersurface intersection homotopy Cohen–Macaulay; p2 mixed-face definition requires dim(sum over I F_i)>=|I| for every I; Corollary1.3 poset rank d−n. This differs from full dimension additivity.
sources.comparison: Vertical F(A,B)×[0,2] with |A|=|B|=2 has dimensions2+2 and sumdim3; included here, excluded in printed question. The larger poset can reconnect endpoint copies.
